title: Witch's Apple Cart — Tens and Ones
description: Fill a friendly witch's cart with trays of ten apples and single apples, then test her magic potion. Random targets from 1 to 100 or a fixed URL target, with touch, mouse and keyboard controls.
learning_intent: Represent numbers to 100 using groups of ten and ones, understanding that one group of ten has the same value as ten individual objects.
